problem_statement: DatasetManager emits an active-dataset-changed notification even when a dataset received from the network has an equal or older Active Timestamp and the local dataset is not saved. Unchanged local datasets must not trigger OT_CHANGED_ACTIVE_DATASET callbacks. A newer received dataset must still trigger the callback when it is saved. Saving through the public otDatasetSetActiveTlvs API must continue to trigger the callback even when its timestamp is older. Preserve existing dataset validation and successful-save notification behavior.
build_command: cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DOT_PLATFORM=external -DOT_BUILD_GTEST=ON -DOT_APP_CLI=OFF -DOT_APP_NCP=OFF -DOT_APP_RCP=OFF -DOT_MTD=OFF -DOT_RCP=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build --target ot-ftd-gtest -j$(nproc)
orientation: The upstream dataset GoogleTests build against the real OpenThread FTD core and fake platform using CMake and Ninja. `run_tests` configures, rebuilds, and runs the selected dataset suite. No radio hardware or emulator is needed. Tests under tests/ are protected.
